[warning] 121-121: `set +e` (or `set +o errexit`) disables the shell's errexit option, so the script keeps running after a command fails. This masks failures of security-critical operations (downloads, signature/checksum verification, permission changes, cleanup of secrets), letting the script proceed with a bad or insecure state. Leave errexit enabled (`set -e` / `set -euo pipefail`), or handle failures explicitly with `if`/`||` and an explicit exit instead of globally turning off failure detection.

## Walkthrough

The inventory script adds `split_reference` to separate image repositories from tags and digests, preserve digests for manifest reads, avoid treating registry ports as tags, and default missing references to `latest`. Manifest probing and rule matching now use this parser. Tests cover exact-rule matching, registry ports, and tag-plus-digest manifest and token requests.
